controlled_count_entry_v1.assert_shared_.new_expression:
declare seen bigint;unique_seen bigint;valid boolean;advisory_valid boolean;
begin
 perform controlled_count_entry_v1.shared_product_resource_origin_catalog_required();
 -- A fresh complete backend lock snapshot for THIS invocation, never a
 -- remembered certificate. Transaction locks remain held until transaction end.
 WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
  select l.* from pg_catalog.pg_locks l
  where l.pid=pg_catalog.pg_backend_pid()and l.database=(select oid from pg_catalog.pg_database where datname=pg_catalog.current_database())and l.granted
 ),resolved AS MATERIALIZED (
  select p.*,c.oid as relation_oid,c.relkind,c.relispartition
  from controlled_count_entry_v1.shared_product_relation_plan_values()p
  left join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.nspname=p.schema_name
  left join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.relnamespace=n.oid and c.relname=p.relation_name
 )
 select count(*),count(distinct r.relation_oid),
 coalesce(bool_and(r.relation_oid is not null and r.relkind='r'and not r.relispartition
  and exists(select 1 from held l where l.locktype='relation'and l.relation=r.relation_oid and l.mode=r.held_mode)),false),
 exists(select 1 from held l where l.locktype='advisory'and l.classid=90271040::oid and l.objid=0::oid and l.objsubid=2 and l.mode='ShareLock')
 into seen,unique_seen,valid,advisory_valid from resolved r;
 if seen<>121 or unique_seen<>121 or valid is not true or advisory_valid is not true then
  raise exception 'count_frontier_invalid'using errcode='P0001',detail='',hint='';end if;
end
